tasks.title: Add ThemeSource.IsMauiElement and make the four ImplicitStyleTests/ThemeDictionaryTests filters require the MAUI namespace
acceptance: T1-01 (C1 declarations). src/DungeonMaster.Tests/App/Theme/ThemeSource.cs declares, inside internal static class ThemeSource, `public const string MauiNamespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui";` and `public static bool IsMauiElement(XElement element, string localName)`, returning true exactly when element.Name equals XName.Get(localName, MauiNamespace), with the semantics and error cases of the frozen contract C:/Users/dmarq/Development/Repos/dungeon-master/.sir/sessions/20261124-0126-maui-namespace-filters/contracts/C1-maui-element.md. Evidence: the declarations as read, plus T1-02 and T1-03.

T1-02. A new [Fact] DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeSourceTests.IsMauiElementMatchesOnlyTheMauiDefaultNamespace parses a synthetic document holding one element of the same local name in each of three namespaces: the MAUI default namespace, a `clr-namespace:` namespace, and the XAML language namespace http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml; it asserts IsMauiElement is true for the MAUI element and false for each of the other two. `dotnet test C:/dm-wt/20261124-0126-maui-namespace-filters/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj --filter 'FullyQualifiedName=DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeSourceTests.IsMauiElementMatchesOnlyTheMauiDefaultNamespace'` prints a summary line with Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Total: 1 (the exact filter selects that one fact; see C2 section 2 at C:/Users/dmarq/Development/Repos/dungeon-master/.sir/sessions/20261124-0126-maui-namespace-filters/contracts/C2-editing-and-injection.md).

T1-03 (C1 Errors). A new [Fact] DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeSourceTests.IsMauiElementThrowsXmlExceptionForAPrefixedName asserts that ThemeSource.IsMauiElement(<an element in the MAUI default namespace>, "x:Style") throws System.Xml.XmlException. The same command shape as T1-02 with this fact's name prints Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Total: 1.

T1-04 (injection H, red, first fact). Following C2 section 2: with the body of ThemeSource.IsMauiElement (one site, in ThemeSource.cs) replaced by `return global::DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeSource.QualifiedElementName(element.Name) == localName;`, the command `dotnet test C:/dm-wt/20261124-0126-maui-namespace-filters/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj --filter 'FullyQualifiedName=DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeSourceTests.IsMauiElementMatchesOnlyTheMauiDefaultNamespace|FullyQualifiedName=DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeSourceTests.IsMauiElementThrowsXmlExceptionForAPrefixedName'` builds and reports IsMauiElementMatchesOnlyTheMauiDefaultNamespace failed (a test failure, not a build error), in a run whose summary shows Total: 2. The report gives the injection window per C2 section 2 step 6.
T1-05 (injection H, red, second fact). In the same run as T1-04, IsMauiElementThrowsXmlExceptionForAPrefixedName is reported failed.

T1-06 (injection H, post-revert). After the injection is reverted and ThemeSource.cs is read back byte-identical to the pre-injection copy, the T1-04 command run on its own (no other tool call in the same batch) prints Failed: 0, Passed: 2, Total: 2.

T1-07 (site ImplicitStyleTests.cs:382 at 452b18f, control). A new [Fact] DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ImplicitStyleTests.SetterPropertiesReadsOnlyMauiNamespaceSetters builds a synthetic resource dictionary in the MAUI default namespace with one Style whose direct children are a MAUI-namespace Setter with Property="Kept" and a Setter with Property="Foreign" in a `clr-namespace:` namespace, and asserts SetterProperties of that style is exactly ["Kept"]. Its exact-name filter run (command shape of T1-02) prints Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Total: 1.

T1-08 (site :382, red). Per C2 section 2, with SetterProperties' element-name test replaced by `global::DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeSource.QualifiedElementName(element.Name) == "Setter"` (the comparison it made at 452b18f), the T1-07 filter run builds and prints Failed: 1, Total: 1.
T1-09 (site :382, post-revert). After revert and byte-identical read-back, the T1-07 filter run on its own prints Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Total: 1.

T1-10 (site ImplicitStyleTests.cs:412 at 452b18f, control). XamlNames' second parameter is named localName. A new [Fact] DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ImplicitStyleTests.XamlNamesReadsOnlyMauiNamespaceElements builds a synthetic MAUI-namespace Style containing a MAUI VisualStateGroup x:Name="KeptGroup" holding a MAUI VisualState x:Name="KeptState", plus a VisualStateGroup x:Name="ForeignGroup" and a VisualState x:Name="ForeignState" in a `clr-namespace:` namespace, and asserts XamlNames(style, "VisualStateGroup") is exactly ["KeptGroup"] and XamlNames(style, "VisualState") is exactly ["KeptState"] (the two names its callers pass at :213 and :222). Its exact-name filter run prints Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Total: 1.

T1-11 (site :412, red). With XamlNames' element-name test replaced by `global::DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeSource.QualifiedElementName(element.Name) == localName`, the T1-10 filter run builds and prints Failed: 1, Total: 1.
T1-12 (site :412, post-revert). After revert and byte-identical read-back, the T1-10 filter run on its own prints Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Total: 1.

T1-13 (site ImplicitStyleTests.cs:448 at 452b18f, control). A new [Fact] DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ImplicitStyleTests.StylesInReadsOnlyMauiNamespaceStyles passes StylesIn a synthetic MAUI-namespace document holding a MAUI Style TargetType="Kept" and a Style TargetType="Foreign" in a `clr-namespace:` namespace, and asserts the returned keys are exactly ["Kept"]. Its exact-name filter run prints Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Total: 1.

T1-14 (site :448, red). With IsStyle's body replaced by `return global::DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeSource.QualifiedElementName(element.Name) == "Style";`, the T1-13 filter run builds and prints Failed: 1, Total: 1.
T1-15 (site :448, post-revert). After revert and byte-identical read-back, the T1-13 filter run on its own prints Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Total: 1.

T1-16 (site ThemeDictionaryTests.cs:407 at 452b18f, seam and control). ThemeDictionaryTests gains `private static IReadOnlyList<string> MergedThemeSourcesIn(XDocument document)` carrying the selection MergedThemeSourcesInAppXaml did inline at 452b18f (:403-420, the `return appXaml` statement through its `.ToList();`), now requiring a MAUI-namespace ResourceDictionary; MergedThemeSourcesInAppXaml keeps its signature, still returns [] when App.xaml is not reached, and otherwise returns MergedThemeSourcesIn(appXaml.Document). A new [Fact] DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeDictionaryTests.MergedThemeSourcesInReadsOnlyMauiNamespaceDictionaries passes it a synthetic document holding a MAUI ResourceDictionary Source="Resources/Theme/Kept.xaml" and a ResourceDictionary Source="Resources/Theme/Foreign.xaml" in a `clr-namespace:` namespace, and asserts the result is exactly ["Resources/Theme/Kept.xaml"]. Its exact-name filter run prints Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Total: 1.

T1-17 (site :407, red). With MergedThemeSourcesIn's element-name test replaced by `global::DungeonMaster.Tests.App.Theme.ThemeSource.QualifiedElementName(element.Name) == "ResourceDictionary"`, the T1-16 filter run builds and prints Failed: 1, Total: 1.
T1-18 (site :407, post-revert). After revert and byte-identical read-back, the T1-16 filter run on its own prints Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Total: 1.

T1-19 (C1 consumers, ImplicitStyleTests). Per C1 (consumers select through ThemeSource.IsMauiElement and re-declare nothing), `grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*///' C:/dm-wt/20261124-0126-maui-namespace-filters/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/App/Theme/ImplicitStyleTests.cs | grep -c 'IsMauiElement('` prints 3 (SetterProperties, XamlNames, IsStyle; it printed 0 at 452b18f). Control that must not change: `grep -cF 'QualifiedElementName(attribute.Name) ==' <same file>` prints 1 (the x:Name attribute site, :417 at 452b18f, out of scope).

T1-20 (C1 consumers, ThemeDictionaryTests). `grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*///' C:/dm-wt/20261124-0126-maui-namespace-filters/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/App/Theme/ThemeDictionaryTests.cs | grep -c 'IsMauiElement('` prints 1 (it printed 0 at 452b18f).

T1-21 (preserved: discussion decision 4). ThemeSource.QualifiedElementName and its two in-file uses are unchanged: in ThemeSource.cs, `grep -cF 'return name.NamespaceName == XamlNamespace'`, `grep -cF 'QualifiedElementName(element.Name),'` (:256 at 452b18f) and `grep -cF 'QualifiedElementName(candidate.Name) == qualifiedElementName'` (:639 at 452b18f) each print 1, as each did at 452b18f. The function's own test is unchanged too: `grep -cF 'ThemeSource.QualifiedElementName(element.Name))' C:/dm-wt/20261124-0126-maui-namespace-filters/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/App/Theme/ThemeSourceTests.cs` prints 1, as it did at 452b18f (:45).

T1-22 (docs). The doc comments of SetterProperties, XamlNames (including its localName <param>), IsStyle and MergedThemeSourcesIn state that the element must be in the MAUI default namespace; `grep -c 'spells it' C:/dm-wt/20261124-0126-maui-namespace-filters/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/App/Theme/ImplicitStyleTests.cs` prints 0 (it printed 1 at 452b18f, :403, XamlNames' old qualified-name <param>).

T1-22b (no session paths). No owned file contains a `.sir/` path: `grep -cF '.sir/' <file>` prints 0 for each of the four owned files (control: the same command prints 24 on C:/Users/dmarq/Development/Repos/dungeon-master/.sir/lessons.md at 452b18f).

T1-23 (C2 section 1, line endings). Every one of the four owned files is CRLF-only after the task: CR count = LF count = CRLF-pair count, by the three commands in C2 section 1 (fixture control there: CR=2 LF=2 CRLF=1).
T1-24 (C2 section 1, indentation). Every one of the four owned files has no space-indented line: `grep -c '^ ' <file>` prints 0 for each (0 for each at 452b18f; control in C2 section 1 prints 20).

T1-25 (build). `dotnet build C:/dm-wt/20261124-0126-maui-namespace-filters/src/DungeonMaster.sln` prints `0 Warning(s)` and `0 Error(s)` (quote the summary lines; baseline 0/0 at 452b18f per the orchestrator's probe).

T1-26 (suite). T1 adds exactly six [Fact]s (T1-02, T1-03, T1-07, T1-10, T1-13, T1-16) and removes or skips none. Relative to T1's startRef 452b18f, where `dotnet test C:/dm-wt/20261124-0126-maui-namespace-filters/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj --no-build` printed Failed: 0, Passed: 1014, Total: 1014, the same command without --no-build (all injections reverted) prints Failed: 0, Passed: 1020, Skipped: 0, Total: 1020.
